summary: This TrueCost report processes three bidder submissions for the Operation and maintenance of 200 electric buses in Bhubaneswar. All three bidders have successfully provided structured pricing models and escalation formulas using official proxy indices for electricity tariff adjustments. GreenMetro, MetroLink, and UrbanDrive are fully processed and ready for evaluation. There are no pending open questions or blocking issues for any of the bidders.
